# Marketplace brand assets

The 31 bundled marks identify the corresponding third-party services; ownership
remains with each brand. sources.json records each retrieved asset, its vendor
source and asset attribution. Simple Icons vectors use the included CC0 notice;
other entries are vendor favicons retrieved through Google's favicon cache and
bundled without image modification. Runtime display does not contact the cache.

The icons are identification assets, not an endorsement or a claim that an
integration has been authorized. No OpenBot art or implementation was copied.
